Leads organic and paid
rows.q2:
During Q2 (July-September), approximately 50-60 leads were generated through organic and paid channels against the annual target of 1,500 leads.

The lower lead generation volume can be attributed to certain operational and infrastructure-related challenges:

 - The absence of a dedicated Performance Marketing resource has affected consistent campaign management, optimisation and scaling of paid acquisition activities.

- The existing website is undergoing revamping to improve user experience, website structure and conversion potential.

- Conversion tracking and analytics infrastructure are being strengthened to ensure accurate lead attribution, measurement of campaign performance and better optimisation.

Plan for Upcoming Quarters - 

 - Onboard a dedicated Performance Marketing resource.

 - Complete the ongoing website revamping.

 - Establish reliable conversion tracking across marketing channels. 

- Improve campaign efficiency and lead quality.

 - Gradually scale organic and paid lead generation in the upcoming quarters.

Target Revision Recommendation: 

Considering the current resource constraints and ongoing website and tracking improvements, the annual target of 1,500 leads should be revisited. A more realistic target should be established based on the availability of resources and the completion of the required infrastructure improvements.

The focus for the upcoming quarters will be to strengthen the acquisition foundation and progressively increase lead generation.
